findings.detail: resolveAgentId trims the persisted suffix but does not re-validate the composed id against the id charset/length, so a hand-tampered or truncated AGENT_ID_FILE could yield an agentId the server rejects via agentIdSchema and it would persist across reboots. Optional: validate the composed id and regenerate on mismatch. Not blocking.

summary: Whole diff reviewed against design, the 59 EARS criteria, and plan: standalone is a faithful byte-for-byte extraction, both-ends command validation, throw-safe safeEqual tokens, never-throw codec, correlation timeout/duplicate/unknown, alias persistence/corrupt-tolerance/concurrency, FleetRegistry isolation + departed-metric prune, unbounded agent backoff with no crash on unreachable peer, and secret redaction are all present and tested; npm run build and npm test (327 passing) are green. Only a NIT remains.
